summary: Whether you show it or not, deep feelings and a strong need to feel safe and a strong pull toward love, beauty, and what you value grind against each other inside you. That friction is the engine you run on. Pushed, your moods run you, or you bury what you actually need. Owned, you read people and care on instinct and you draw people in and know what you want.

Likable and warm; watch indulgence and shaky money instincts. Care and affection may not always feel like the same thing. There can be a pull between emotional safety and the desire to be liked, wanted, or chosen.
gift: At your best: you read people and care on instinct, and you draw people in and know what you want.
shadow: The trap: your moods run you, or you bury what you actually need — or you smooth things over, or lose yourself in wanting it.
integration: Let emotional needs and love and values cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Likable and warm; watch indulgence and shaky money instincts.
do: Use it on purpose, not on reflex

dont: Let the reflex make the decision
